rainier.description: Mount Rainier, WA, USA. Glaciated stratovolcano; US high-resolution elevation coverage.

mont-blanc.description: Mont Blanc massif and the Chamonix valley, France/Italy. Non-US coverage.

bonneville.description: Bonneville Salt Flats, UT, USA. Flat and bare (about 1283 m), for checking vertical datum offsets between sources; a small hill rises in the north-west corner.

glacier-waterton.description: US-Canada border between Glacier and Waterton Lakes national parks. Tests the US 3DEP -> global Copernicus seam.

everest.description: Mount Everest, Lhotse and the Khumbu glacier, Nepal/China. Highest terrain; east longitudes.

aconcagua.description: Aconcagua, Argentina. Highest peak of the southern and western hemispheres.

denali.description: Denali, Alaska, USA. 3DEP exists here but GEOID18 does not: unconverted cells must be reported and filled by Copernicus.

mauna-kea.description: Mauna Kea summit, Hawaii, USA. 3DEP outside GEOID18, like Alaska.

kilimanjaro.description: Kibo summit of Kilimanjaro, Tanzania. Southern hemisphere just below the equator, east longitude.

svalbard.description: Longyearbyen and Adventfjorden, Svalbard, Norway (78N). High latitude; Copernicus cells are narrower in longitude here.

fiordland.description: Milford Sound and Mitre Peak, Fiordland, New Zealand. Southern hemisphere, east longitude, fjord at sea level. Copernicus has a pit to about -75 m at the head of the sound (a surface-model artifact by the steep shore), so the lower bound allows it.

taveuni.description: Taveuni, Fiji: the 180th meridian crosses the island. bbox west > east means the box crosses the antimeridian.

dead-sea.description: Dead Sea shore at Ein Gedi, Israel/West Bank, and the Judean Desert escarpment. Lowest land on Earth (about -430 m).

death-valley.description: Badwater Basin and the Black Mountains, Death Valley, CA, USA. Below sea level inside CONUS (3DEP + GEOID18).

flevoland.description: Lelystad and the Flevoland polders, Netherlands. Flat reclaimed land a few meters below sea level, next to the Markermeer. expectedElevation is the ground; trees and buildings in the surface model stay within the tolerance.

greenwich.description: Greenwich, London, UK: the prime meridian. Surface model includes the Canary Wharf towers.

mount-kenya.description: Mount Kenya, Kenya. The box crosses the equator.

grand-canyon.description: Grand Canyon around Phantom Ranch, AZ, USA. 1.5 km of relief from the Colorado River to the rims.

table-mountain.description: Table Mountain and central Cape Town, South Africa, down to Table Bay.

torres-del-paine.description: Paine Grande and the Cuernos del Paine, Chile. Patagonia: southern and western hemispheres.

cell-corner-46n8e.description: Saas valley and Macugnaga, Switzerland/Italy, east of Monte Rosa. Straddles the 46N 8E corner of four Copernicus 1-degree cells. Lowest ground is Valle Anzasca near Ceppo Morelli (about 700 m).

pacific.description: Open ocean in the central Pacific, 10N 140W. No elevation files at all: the whole grid should be NaN.
